title: Molecular Docking with Quantum Circuit Evolution
summary: Molecular docking is an important step in drug discovery, enabling the evaluation of receptor-ligand affinity while reducing experimental costs and increasing the number of possible tests. However, the high computational cost associated with molecular docking remains a limiting factor that can restrict both the experimental precision and the scale of the problems being addressed. To improve the future applicability of molecular docking, recent works have proposed the use of quantum algorithms based on Gaussian Boson Sampling quantum computers and also gate-based quantum computers.
